about: D19 (docs/language-packs.md §2.1): every grammar page has a contrast note for each SUPPORTED native (the languages of the UI locales) other than the page's own language, and one for each entry of `types` (a type note names no language). Only those notes are shown: a learner with a supported native sees the note for it; any other learner sees the note for their branch, family or type. The other languages of `languages` (the reference set of D18, chosen by the user 2026-10-09) keep their notes as source material — never shown — and serve inference by type and family.
